holdings.thesis: HOLD: Q2 FY27 results (reported 9/2/26) were a record beat -- revenue $384M vs. $299M consensus, EPS $3.76 vs. $2.66 est., record net income $53M and adjusted EBITDA $70M, Power segment revenue +53% YoY to $301M. Shares reacted positively (+1.4% intraday) rather than selling off further, validating the growth case the last two stop-loss trims were de-risking ahead of. Holding the reduced position steady rather than trimming further given the print resolved the near-term uncertainty in our favor.

TRIMMED 30%: Q1 FY27 results (9/1/26) beat on revenue (+114.7% YoY to $479M) and EPS, but Q2 guidance of $525-535M undershot elevated Street expectations and gross margin slipped to 64.5%, triggering a two-day, ~27% sell-off to a return of -38.9% vs. cost basis (past the -25% stop-loss threshold). JPMorgan cut its PT to $310 (from $335) and BofA to $275 (from $340), both still rating it Buy/Overweight, and FY27 guidance still implies 85%+ revenue growth -- so trimming to de-risk the guidance miss and top-3-customer concentration (88% of revenue) while keeping a smaller position for the still-intact growth story. Also helps keep the Technology sector under its 30% cap.

HOLD: thesis intact. Evercore's 9/1/26 upgrade to Outperform ($210 PT) continues to support the stock; DAU +23% YoY to 58.7M, paid subscribers +17% YoY, revenue +18% YoY to $298.5M. Earnings-growth flag reflects AI-feature reinvestment, not a slowdown -- no new data today changes that read.

HOLD: price roughly flat vs. yesterday (-31.6% vs. cost basis, essentially unchanged from -31.1%) with no new negative catalyst -- the insider-selling/CEO-transition overhang (effective 9/30/26) is unchanged and already fully reflected in the two prior trims that cut this position by ~85% combined. Position is now minimal (1.4% of portfolio), so holding rather than trimming further; will revisit if the CEO transition or fresh insider filings bring new information.

HOLD: thesis strengthening -- Vertiv raised full-year 2026 guidance to $14B revenue and $6.70 adjusted EPS and announced a $2.6B grid/microgrid acquisition; GLJ Research upgraded to Buy with a $381 PT, and the 28-analyst consensus remains Strong Buy. The Pomerantz/Hagens Berman/Schall securities-litigation investigations are still open but show no escalation since the last review, so this is a hold, not a further trim.

HOLD: thesis intact, no new catalyst today. Google Cloud revenue +82% YoY offsets AI-talent-departure and search-growth concerns behind a recent pullback; the DOJ Chrome/Android divestiture overhang is unchanged from the original thesis, not a new break.

HOLD: thesis intact. Q2 beat the high end of guidance on both lines (revenue +20% YoY constant currency, operating margin 13.7% vs. 11.4% a year ago); Zoox is now expanding robotaxi service into new markets alongside AWS's continued growth.

HOLD: thesis intact and strengthening. Q2 adjusted earnings $14.7B, Q3 dividend raised to $1.03/share; shares continue to benefit from rising oil prices on Middle East tensions plus renewed energy-deal activity in Venezuela.

HOLD: thesis strengthening -- shares +6% today after BofA raised its PT to $104 (from $93, kept Buy) and Scotiabank initiated coverage at Sector Outperform with a $95 PT, both citing the FQ4 beat. FY26 revenue growth 33%, forward P/E 14.4.
HOLD: thesis intact, no new catalyst today (return -6.5% vs. cost basis, in line with yesterday). Q2 revenue +36% YoY, FY26 guidance raised, AI-observability demand story unchanged.

HOLD: thesis strengthening -- Q2 revenue +48% YoY to $23B on GLP-1 (Mounjaro/Zepbound) strength; FY26 guidance raised to $85-87B revenue and $35.50-36.50 EPS, above Street's $32.80 estimate, and shares popped 4% on the print.

HOLD: shares down 4% today as rising long-duration Treasury yields pressure the loan book's fair-value marks and net interest margin (management flagged a 37bp benchmark-rate impact) -- a real near-term headwind, but Q2 fundamentals (revenue +40% YoY, record member/product adds, $45.5B deposits) are unchanged, so this is a rate-sensitivity watch item, not a thesis break.
HOLD: thesis intact, no new catalyst today. Buy consensus PT $975.61, record $72B backlog, AI-driven autonomous-equipment demand; Burry's short remains a contrarian watch item, not a new signal.

BUY: Q2 revenue $80.1M, +287% YoY, drove a raised FY26 guidance to $280-290M; remaining performance obligations (contracted, unrecognized revenue) rose 297% YoY to $485M. New partnerships with Anduril and Sandia National Labs, SkyWater acquisition closed, and 11 of 13 analysts rate it Buy/Strong Buy. Quantum-computing pure-play sourced from the weekly theme screen; sized modestly given elevated valuation (~52x forward sales) and the 9/30/26 public-warrant expiration as a near-term dilution/selling-pressure watch item. Market cap $15.25B keeps this outside the opportunity-tier bucket, which has no remaining room today.
